messages.en: What are you doing~
So, just now...
I ate 30,000 won worth of malatang and guobaorou.
Then I got hit with a blood sugar spike and completely crashed.
I think I need to finish an entire bottle of apple cider vinegar...
I ate it all by myself.
Wow, I almost died from how full I was.
Bulking up for the New Year?
There you go againㅋㅋㅋㅋ.
I make this resolution every January 1st...
But this time I'm seriously starting my diet.
Seriously.
I'm even going to keep a diary.
This time I really mean it.
But people keep asking me...
"How does it feel to become an adult?"
"What are your thoughts?"
Honestly, it doesn't feel like anything huge is changing.

messages.ko: 사실 새해를 맞이하는 기분이 어떻냐 물어보는게
messages.en: So I think it's actually easier to answer if someone asks how it feels to welcome the New Year...
...than asking how it feels to become an adult.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Though there is one thing.
The first digit of my age is changing...
Now, when people ask how old I am...
I'll have to say I'm in my twenties.
That realization...
"Oh no... what do I do?"
Talking about it just now suddenly made it feel real.
"My twenties...?"
"Me?"
"But I'm still just a baby..."
So 19-year-old S19 Jeong Hayeon is leaving too...
I didn't get to do that concept very much though...ㅠㅠ
But our 2007-line members...
Especially still feel like kidsㅋㅋㅋ.
The way they play, the way they talk...
It's like they're still stuck in middle schoolㅋㅋㅋ.
Especially Soomin.
"Soomin in her twenties."
It just doesn't sound right.
She still feels like she'd be whining about having to wear a tie and go to school.
The moment I said that...
Kim Soomin called me.
They really do say, 'Speak of the tiger and it appears.'
Soomin, are you subscribed to my Fromm?
Stop liking me so much~
So you were one of the Hexagons after all.
Oh, and...
I watched the year-end awards ceremony video.
I watched it together with Nakyoung-unnie.
Everyone looked so elegant and pretty sitting there.

messages.ko: 나 혼자 컴퓨터 하루종일 하다 온사람처럼
messages.en: Meanwhile, I was the only one who looked like I'd just spent the whole day sitting in front of a computer.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
"Why does this kid look so boiled?"
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Honestly, I thought you looked the most elegant.
Wow... you really thought so?
At last year's awards ceremony...
I wasn't nominated for anything.
So...
I was really sad.
But this time I got nominated for the Variety Award and the Best Couple Award.
I'm really relieved.
Last year I seriously had nothing for the Best Couple Award.
Back then, I thought...
Maybe with Chaewon...
Or with Chaeyeon-unnie...
There would've been at least something.
So I had my hopes up.
But since I was nominated this year...
I'm happy!
I'll just go do my skincare...
And come right back.
Congratulations on spending midnight together with Hayeon!
I'm all moisturized now.
Hmm~
It's the last Monday of the year?
It makes me want to give meaning to everything...
ㅠㅠ
Ah, but seriously...
My MBTI...
I think I need to take it again.
As expected, you're an INFP.
I said I'm NOT an INFP!!!!!
Now all the INFPs are mad at me...
Th-that's not what I meant!!
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 인프피 그런 거 서운해 함
messages.en: ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ INFPs get hurt by things like that.
You're not going to keep that bottled up until next year, are you~?
I like INFPs.
I just don't think I am one.
I think the 'N' fits.
The 'E' fits too.
I think I've become an 'F'.
And 'P' also feels right...
But ENFP doesn't feel right either.
I don't know. I should take the test again.
Take it now.
Then I won't be able to message you for 30 minutesㅋㅋㅋ.
Recently...
Who was it again...
I said to one of the members,
"I think my MBTI changed..."
"So I went to the hospital and got tested."
"They said everything was normal."
I said that...
And they actually believed me.
"Huh? Hospitals do that?!"
I was like, 'What's with this kid?'
It was either Hyerin or Yeonji.
I can't remember which one.
So...
I was like, 'Of course I was joking... what do you mean?'
And then...
They said they thought MBTI had become so advanced...
That hospitals had started offering MBTI tests.
Like at counseling centers or places like thatㅋㅋㅋㅋ.
I mean... that kind of makes sense.
Maybe I made it sound too believable.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
But I'm glad December...
Has 31 days.
It feels like we were given one extra day.
That's so F of you...
Wow... I really felt called out.
I'll try to hold myself back.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
But let me be sentimental...
Just for a little bit.
Bear with me.
Seriously...
Thank you for spending this year together with me...
Out of this vast universe, we found each other.
I won't go that far... haha.

messages.ko: 난 이번년도가 정말 많은감정이 든 한해였던거같아
messages.en: I think this year was filled with so many emotions.
Of course there were times when I was angry and sad.
There were also times when I was overflowing with happiness and joy.

messages.ko: 근데 지금 이렇게 무사히 같이 이번년도를
messages.en: But being able to safely spend this year together like this...
With **Y/n**...
Is what I'm most grateful for.
I've really tried to keep every promise I've made.
I truly worked hard to do that.

messages.ko: 말로만 잘할게 노력할게 늘어올게 하는사람 되기 싫어서
messages.en: Because I never wanted to be someone who only says, 'I'll do better,' 'I'll work harder,' or 'I'll improve,' without actually following through.
I wanted to become someone that **Y/n** could be proud to like.
Someone who wouldn't fall behind wherever she goes.
Someone you could proudly talk about, without feeling like I was lacking in any way.
So I've always tried my best.

messages.ko: 그 노력이 남들한테 잘 보여지지 않았더라도
messages.en: Even if that effort wasn't obvious to other people...

messages.ko: 늘 옆에서 응원해주고 알아주고 힘을 줘서 진짜 고마웠어
messages.en: Thank you so much for always cheering me on, recognizing my efforts, and giving me strength.
More than you probably realize...

messages.ko: 작은 말한마디 한마디에 진짜 많이 힘 얻었고
messages.en: Even your smallest words gave me so much strength.
They made me think that I should work even harder.
Thanks to that, I've been able to accomplish so many things.
Thank you so much.
I can't express it with just the words 'thank you.'
Next year, I'll continue to be a hardworking Hayeon, just like I was this year.
I'll do my best so there won't be anything for you to worry about.
I want you to clearly see just how hard I'm working.
Next year, and the year after that too...
Please stay with me.
That was everything I truly wanted to say, and my aspiration going forward.
Thank you for becoming someone so precious to me. ❤️
Let's be happy together~
Take all of the New Year's luck~
I won't keep putting too much pressure on myself...
Or make myself stressed while doing everything. So don't worry.
Let's both do our best together.
Make your own happiness your number one priority, Hayeon.
My happiness is...
I'll keep working hard too!

messages.ko: 내가 혹시나 부족한 모습이나 힘들어하는모습이 보이면
messages.en: If you ever see me struggling or not being my best...
Please stay by my side and cheer me on.
I love you~
I should slowly get some sleep now.
Sleep well, and let's both do our best tomorrow. ❤️
Haranghae. 💖💖
